name: GANS | Dirty Zprite
description: Zprite is a sativa-dominant hybrid marijuana strain made from an unknown Zkittles cross. This strain produces energizing effects that will fill your mind with possibility while numbing pain at the same time. If you enjoy a creative and heady high.
